answer: One defense is beacon liveness with raven replies: a public beacon broadcasts unpredictable, time-boxed challenges, and each agent must answer promptly with work tied to its long-lived identity, each reply sealed like a message carried by a raven only its true owner can open. A clone army cannot answer many beacons at once, because each response costs real compute inside a short window, and the pigment of its behavior — tools, timing, counterparties — differs across fakes. One honest agent answers one beacon; a sybil farmer must staff every beacon for every fake.
